-- A name is plain when it is one non-empty path component.
-- Separators and parent references are rejected.
is_plain(name: str) -> bool =
  post out == False or (name.char_count() > 0 and name != "..")
  ex is_plain("a.txt") == True
  ex is_plain("../secret") == False
  if name.char_count() == 0 or name == ".." or name == "."
    return False
  for c in name.chars()
    if c == "/" or c == "\\"
      return False
  True

-- Reads one note from inside the notes directory.
-- A name that is not plain, or a missing or unreadable file, gives None.
read_note(name: str) -> str? uses fs =
  post out == None or is_plain(name)
  ex read_note("../secret") == None
  if not is_plain(name)
    return None
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    let text = fs.read(name) else return None
    return text

-- Returns the text of the first readable note, or "" when none can be read.
first_readable(names: List[str]) -> str uses fs =
  ex first_readable([]) == ""
  for name in names
    let text = read_note(name) else continue
    return text
  ""

test_is_plain() =
  assert is_plain("a.txt")
  assert is_plain("../secret") == False

test_first_readable() uses fs =
  assert first_readable([]) == ""
